changelog:
v1.24.6 - Fix prop models fallback to placeholders in exported builds by replacing FileAccess.file_exists with ResourceLoader.exists in Prop.gd.
v1.24.5 - Add pre-heat asset import caching step to CI/CD pipeline and configure it to use the opengl3 rendering driver to prevent headless texture compression glitches.
v1.24.4 - Fix enemy spawner fallback to deleted old_lady config by updating default and fallback values to vecchia_mattarello in EnemySpawner.gd and Enemy.gd.
